text: てがみが　ついてる……　レッドへ　がんばってる　レッドに　ランニングシューズを　プレゼントするわ！

structure.jp: てがみが　ついてる……
がんばってる　レッドに
structure.en: to Red, who is working hard

structure.jp: ランニングシューズを　プレゼントするわ！
structure.en: I'm giving Running Shoes as a present!

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that is still going on; てる is the short spoken form. てがみが　ついてる = 'a letter is attached'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: がんばってる　レッド
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a person or thing describes them. がんばってる　レッド = 'Red, who is working hard'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end gives a soft, womanly tone to a statement. プレゼントするわ = 'I'm giving it as a present'.
